_comment: What the fleet is SUPPOSED to contain, for check-edge-code-live.mjs.
Same house rule as supabase-projects-baseline.json: a written-down expectation, so a gap
is a FACT instead of a guess. Without this file, a repo nobody can read is ABSENT, and
absent reads as fine — the exact hole that made check-supabase-build-currency print
'21 projects checked, 0 behind' while a product went unwatched (2026-08-30).
prod: the PRODUCTION Supabase project ref. null means NOT YET ESTABLISHED — the repo is
still listed, and the check reports it as UNPROVEN coverage rather than skipping it.
Only refs verified against the live Management API on 2026-09-02 are filled in here.
branch: the ref that is actually deployable. Deliberately the REMOTE branch, because a
commit that exists only on this machine is not something anyone can ship.
